column1: I woke up in a panic at the crack of noon
The whispered sweet nothings are louder than before
I guess I'll start using again
I swear that I've been steadier than ever was
Or so I choose to believe
I guess that all pressure was slowly building up
The spring was spent driven at the rate of speed
Fall and winter I can't quite remember
But the scars on my arms are new
I haven't seen a mirror in a year or so
Brother now I know where you've been
To start it all over or stick to staying sober
Maybe you were born for abuse
It's best to start forgetting again
